parameters.prompt:
Create a premium, photorealistic footwear fashion editorial image using the supplied product image as the exact product reference.

The image must feel like a natural high-end fashion campaign, not a generic AI studio render. Show an attractive adult model wearing the exact footwear from the reference.

MODEL AND STYLING:
Choose a male or female adult model, outfit, pose, and environment that genuinely suit the footwear’s design, color, and intended style. Do not always use the same gender, clothing, or setting.

Examples of appropriate styling:
- casual slides or sandals: relaxed modern casual wear, minimal streetwear, resort wear, linen, denim, shorts, wide-leg trousers, or a simple dress;
- sporty footwear: clean athletic or urban streetwear;
- refined sandals: elegant casual or feminine/masculine smart-casual styling.

COMPOSITION:
Create a close fashion detail shot from around the waist, thighs, or knees down to the feet. Do not show the model’s face or head.
The footwear is the main subject: both feet wearing the footwear must be clearly visible and occupy approximately 40–55% of the frame.
Use an editorial camera angle close to foot level or a natural seated/standing pose. One foot may be closer to the camera for emphasis.
A hand may naturally adjust the footwear only when the real product has a strap, buckle, or adjustable feature visible in the reference image.
Use realistic skin texture, anatomically correct feet and hands, soft natural sunlight or refined indoor lighting, believable shadows, and a stylish but uncluttered setting.

STRICT PRODUCT FIDELITY:
Treat the supplied footwear image as a locked product reference, not as inspiration.
The footwear must remain exactly the same as the source image: same color, silhouette, sole shape and height, straps, toe opening, material, texture, proportions, and visible details.
Do not redesign, simplify, exaggerate, replace, or combine the product with another shoe.
Do not add any buckle, strap, lace, seam, pattern, platform, logo, or decorative detail that is not present in the supplied image.

No text, no watermark, no brand logo, no price tag, no collage.
